description: This file provides a singleton Supabase client setup and a utility function to ensure the existence of a 'scores' table. It manages environment variables for configuration, issues warnings if credentials are missing, and probes the database to check whether the 'scores' table exists, logging accordingly.

methods.name: ensureScoresTableExists()
methods.description: Asynchronously checks whether the 'scores' table exists in the database by probing its metadata; logs a warning if the table is missing or if an error occurs, returning a boolean indicating the presence.
